text: Introduction： This program will enable students to know about basic theory and skill of modern oil gas geological science and students can be trained as geological engineers. After graduating, students can work in the field of oil gas resource prospecting and other relative fields for engineering design, and management. Curriculum： Oral Chinese, Advanced Mathematics, Chinese Intensive Reading, A Survey of China, Geological Resource and geological Engineering, Oil Gas Geology and Prospecting, Sedimentlogy, Subsurface Geology of Oil and Gas Field. Architectonic Geology, Theory and Explanation of Seismic Prospecting.
